title: Maula Naqi (AS) K Jashan Ki Mehfil Saji Hai Aaj
body:
Har Su Fiza Ye Dekhiye Mahki Hui Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula Naqi (a.s) K Jashan Ki Mahfil Saji Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Huro Malak Bhi Khuld Se Aaye Hain Dosto
Ghar Main Taqi Kay Amad e Moula Naqi Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehmat Baras Rahi Hai Khuda Ki Jahan Main
Sallay Ala Kay Nagmay Hawa Gah Rahi Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Aale Nabi He Hain Faqat Wo Noor e Kibriya
Inkay Siwa Jahan Main Kahin Roshni Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham Gham Manayen Ya Khushi Hairat Ki Baath Hain
Kyun Aag Munkiron K dilon Main Lagi Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaly Nabi Se Dushmani Rakhe Jo Dil Main Bhugz
Ussay Bara Jahan Mai Koi Lanati Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajday Main Sir Hussain (a.s) Ka Gardan Pah Taigh Hai
Asi Namaz Phir Kahin Dekhi Gai Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Zehra (s.a) Tumaray Bachon Ka Mujh Pay Hai Ye Karam
Kitni Mujeh Zamanay main Izzat Mili Hai Aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
Kami Bari Zeya Koi Aai Hai Ye Pasand
Jo Manqabat Imam Ki Tu Ne Likhi Hai Aaj
